title: How a Car Differential Works in 60 Seconds ⚙️🚗 #shorts
description:
In every turn, your outer wheels travel farther than the inner ones. The differential lets them spin at different speeds: a pinion turns a big ring gear, and little spider gears inside share the power between the two wheels. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#differential #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Problem
steps.text: In every turn, your *outer wheels* travel farther than the inner ones.

steps.label: Locked Axle
steps.text: If both wheels were locked together, one tire would have to *skid* in every corner.

steps.label: Ring & Pinion
steps.text: So the driveshaft spins a small *pinion*, which turns a big *ring gear* around the axle.

steps.label: Spider Gears
steps.text: The ring gear carries a cage with little *spider gears*, which push on both axle gears.

steps.label: Straight
steps.text: Driving straight, the spider gears don't spin. Everything turns as *one piece*.

steps.label: Turning
steps.text: In a turn, the spider gears *rotate*, letting the outer wheel speed up as the inner one slows down.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Different speeds, same *push*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
